addons.name: Lyre Design
addons.summary: Turn a brief into an editable HTML design in a workspace panel while your Lyre agents edit the same artifacts.
addons.reason: Download published as the stable lyre-design-v0.1.0 release with a ZIP and checksum. Installed-host acceptance passed on an isolated 0.1.10 daemon for install, runtime and all twelve design tools. Browser panel, sidebar screen, preview rendering and installed-desktop checks remain pending.
requirements: Requires foundation >=0.11.2 and Lyre >=0.1.9 <0.3.0 or the specific 0.2.0-test prerelease. Agent tools require a host advertising Lyre extension tools.
Owner access to the selected host is required to install, enable and use it. The sandboxed live preview runs in Lyre desktop or a browser; phones show an availability state instead.
setup: When a qualified package is published, verify its checksum, extract it into a permanent folder on the host computer and install through Settings > Add-ons (Settings > Plugins on Lyre 0.1.10). Review the source first: add-ons run trusted code.

Enable it, then open Design from the sidebar (or Lyre Design from workspace panels, or Open Lyre Design in Command Center), choose a workspace, and start from a template or ask an agent to create a design with get_design_guide.

Your workspace agents discover the design tools on their own. Panel edits and agent edits share one revision history, so Undo works for both. Download the HTML from the panel and print that file when a PDF is needed.

addons.name: Amble Craft Anything
addons.summary: Study how a website, app or game works with real inspection tools, then let your connected Amble agent build your own version.
addons.reason: Wraps Craft Anything (MIT OR Apache-2.0, early alpha) pinned to a checksum-verified release. Windows x64 install and MCP initialize were exercised; macOS, Linux and the end-to-end agent flow in a running Amble host are not verified. No packaged add-on download is published yet.
requirements: Requires foundation >=0.11.2. Agent tools require a host advertising Amble extension tools.
Owner access to the selected host is required to install, enable and use it. Use it only on software you own or may examine.
setup: When a package is published, verify its checksum, extract it into a permanent folder on the host computer and install through Settings > Add-ons. Review the source first: add-ons run trusted code.
Open the Amble Craft Anything panel and choose Install; it downloads the pinned Craft Anything release, checks its SHA-256 and unpacks it. Nothing downloads until you press the button.
Pick a connected agent, a kind, a target and a request. The agent studies the target in clean-room mode and builds with your own provider permissions.
